cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I joined in when your cousin clapped. Where does that put me for club president?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He was testing the microphone, not applauding. You clapped through the chair's speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, checking the room. What counts toward choosing the next president?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Members vote. My cousin promised to fix the car park; that would save my tyres.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How many votes has that promise got him compared with me? I'll know whether to talk about the road or the roof.

reason: Rebuild the same-holder combination around an actual misread confident behavior and a concrete Drive request. Give B's correction or offer control over the next tactic.
